description: The docs say media drawn alone, such as a status dot, needs a PreviewCard that shows its word, and peek or the item's page to reach it by keyboard. The default media's child fills the 24×24px slot, so a card trigger in it takes the whole slot as its hover target.

Renames the row parts to plain words: RecordRowIdentify is RecordRowSubject, RecordRowRead is RecordRowFact, RecordRowKey is RecordRowId and RecordRowGlyph is RecordRowMedia. RecordRowMedia adds variant icon, one 16px muted icon with no fill, named by its required label; a loading row draws it as a 16px block. RecordRowFact adds missing (unavailable or hidden), which replaces the removed field-state item.
Includes every RecordRow part, which the removed record-row item used to ship: import RecordRow, RecordRowLink and the other parts from @/components/record-list.
The docs link to this item's playground page at /playground/components/record-list.
Assessed against the lifecycle criteria: beta. Its design critique is not yet clean: the status shows as a dot with no visible word (issue #44).
Installs into your components folder, so import it from @/components.
Merges class names with the cn item, so a className override replaces a token utility.
